requirement: The site proxy lets the Tracy Business theme's tracy_style cookie through both ways while every other Tracy cookie stays blocked, and the demo address probe uses the deployment's own scheme and port

oracle.ref: PR #1539 (fix); fix evidence: QA flows case audit-cms-001-01 expected cookie tracy_style=airbnb after ?style=airbnb and got none; demos bootstrapped on a local stand failed ADDRESS_SHADOWED because the probe asked https without port. The concurrent releases read (23505 on question_set_released) is covered by apps/tracy-web/test/quickstart-releases-race.test.mjs, which needs TEST_DATABASE_URL and runs in CI under ci:integration.
oracle.invariant: S1: only tracy_style reaches the browser and only tracy_style reaches the site; every other listed cookie is dropped in both directions on both address kinds; the workspace path drops tracy_style too. S2: the probe goes to http://<label>.tracy.test:51710/__tracy/address-probe and the demo is not failed ADDRESS_SHADOWED; a bare config gives the same address as bornSiteAddress; an https origin without port and a target with its own scheme and port are unchanged.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
